sources.title: Worst-Case Performance Bounds for Simple One-Dimensional Packing Algorithms
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Primary article defining and analysing First Fit, Best Fit and decreasing-order variants.
sources.notes: The publisher abstract states the 1.7 OPT + 2 and 11/9 OPT + 4 style bounds; exact theorem use requires checking the article.

sources.title: A Method for Solving Traveling-Salesman Problems
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Original 2-edge exchange method record and an explicit statement that search can be stopped at any point.
sources.notes: The source discusses symmetric and asymmetric settings; implementation assumptions must be checked separately.

sources.title: An Analysis of Several Heuristics for the Traveling Salesman Problem
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Primary worst-case analysis for nearest-neighbour, nearest insertion and cheapest insertion.
sources.notes: Bounds assume the metric/triangle-inequality conditions stated by the source.

sources.title: Scheduling of Vehicles from a Central Depot to a Number of Delivery Points
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Original savings procedure for depot vehicle routing with capacity-aware route merging.
sources.notes: The source describes an iterative procedure; exact tie-breaking and feasibility checks are implementation details.

sources.title: Improvement of the Nearest Neighbor Heuristic Search Algorithm for Traveling Salesman Problem
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Abstract describes a deterministic nearest-neighbor tour construction that repeatedly adds the closest city, matching the target Nearest Neighbor / next_node_score entrypoint.
sources.notes: Not the classical Rosenkrantz–Stearns–Lewis nearest neighbor; a 2024 deterministic NNA variant that initializes from the globally shortest edge. Evaluator still starts at city 0, so the seed-edge step cannot be reproduced in select_next_node.

sources.title: A Generalized Insertion Heuristic for the Traveling Salesman Problem with Time Windows
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Original TSPTW insertion construction with neighbourhood insert, reoptimization, feasibility/backtracking, and remove-reinsert post-optimization
sources.notes: Insertion into a partial tour is not select_next_node. Not Solomon I1; Gendreau et al. generalized insertion for TSPTW.

sources.title: Penerapan Algoritma Clarke and Wright Saving dalam Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem dengan Optimasi Nearest Neighbor untuk Rute Terpendek
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Abstract states Nearest Neighbor is used to order visits, which is next-customer scoring by proximity.
sources.notes: Application paper: Clarke-Wright forms routes, then NN orders visits. Evaluator already filters capacity; this adapter is only the NN choice, not CW merge and not Sweep.

sources.title: A Heuristic Approach Based on Clarke‐Wright Algorithm for Open Vehicle Routing Problem
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Open-VRP adaptation of Clarke-Wright with formula modification and open-route construction.
sources.notes: CW merge of routes is not select_next_node. Abstract does not use savings as a next-customer score.

sources.title: Variable Sized Bin Packing
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Original paper giving three efficient approximation algorithms for a fixed collection of bin sizes.
sources.notes: Not a 1D online score(item, bins) rule; not named variable-size FFD.

sources.title: New Bounds for Variable-Sized Online Bin Packing
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: New algorithms for variable-sized online bin packing.
sources.notes: Online variable-sized packing; registered OBP interface has a single bin size.

sources.title: Best Fit Bin Packing with Random Order Revisited
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Abstract studies the online Best Fit bin-packing algorithm.
sources.notes: Paper analyses random-order Best Fit. Adapter is -bins on feasible residuals; First Fit scan-order is not this score. Memory-allocation first-fit paper was dropped.

sources.title: A New Bottom-Left-Fill Heuristic Algorithm for the Two-Dimensional Irregular Packing Problem
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.notes: 2D irregular stock-cutting BLF, not 1D online score and not classical rectangular strip Bottom-Left.

sources.title: A Tight Asymptotic Bound for Next-Fit-Decreasing Bin-Packing
sources.venue: SIAM Journal on Algebraic Discrete Methods
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Offline decreasing Next-Fit approximation for one-dimensional bin packing.
sources.notes: NFD not FFD/Karmarkar-Karp. Sorting the full list is not online score(item, bins).

sources.title: An Effective Heuristic Algorithm for the Traveling-Salesman Problem
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Original variable-depth TSP heuristic (Lin and Kernighan 1973).
sources.notes: Variable-depth search is not select_2opt_move. Registered tsp_2opt only offers improving 2-opt candidates.

sources.title: Chained Lin-Kernighan for Large Traveling Salesman Problems
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Chained Lin-Kernighan for very large TSPLIB instances.
sources.notes: Still variable-depth search, not candidate-list 2-opt move_selector.

sources.title: A simple on-line bin-packing algorithm
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Original Lee-Lee HARMONIC_M online algorithm with Harmonic size classes.
sources.notes: Class-dedicated bins are not a score over the evaluator residual vector unless rewritten as such. Do not treat this as the Go/Python score elites.

sources.title: Improved Space for Bounded-Space, On-Line Bin-Packing
sources.license: copyrighted; release contains citation and autonomous summary only
sources.selection_reason: Bounded-space online algorithms based on Harmonic H_k with fewer active bins.
sources.notes: Class-dedicated Harmonic is not residual bin_score. Registered OBP does not cap the number of open bins in the evolved function.
